TEN_GOD_FRIEND.name: The Narrative of Solidarity and Equality
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.headline: This year, you will grow into someone who builds a solid community with reliable colleagues.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.body:
The core narrative running through your year is not a lonely solo journey, but forming a solid scrum with people who share your goals. You will break free from the weight you carried alone and create horizontal partnerships that acknowledge each other's strengths.

Through this process, you will let go of the pressure to lead others and learn the joy of walking side by side. The synergy created when people who have done their best in their own places meet is much more massive and warm than you think.

The framework of honest solidarity built over a year will become the strongest fence supporting your life. Lean on each other's shoulders and enjoy a true sense of belonging and stability.

It will be a valuable time to realize that going far together is often more valuable than going fast alone. I cheer for you to draw a trajectory of brilliant growth with the precious connections by your side.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.watch_for: Losing your unique color and subjectivity by being swept away by the group's atmosphere.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.lean_into: Building a long-term core colleague network that respects each other's autonomy.

TEN_GOD_FRIEND.name: Building the Future Together
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.headline: This year, you will become a leader of solidarity who expands personal goals into collective synergy.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.body:
This is the year to set a massive milestone with companions who support each other at an equal eye level. The warmth and authenticity within you will naturally attract those around you and form a massive driving force.

You will experience the joy of remarkable achievement by sharing long-term tasks that you couldn't dare to do alone. As you fill in each other's shortcomings and exchange inspiration, your perspective will broaden even further.

During this time, sharing your knowledge and heart generously becomes a shortcut to raising your value. The time spent laughing and sharing concerns with those around you will accumulate as your most shining asset.

A future built together beyond individual power gives you heart-swelling emotion. Open your heart, reach out your hand, and take a powerful step toward shared success.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.watch_for: Compromising your core values too easily to avoid friction with those around you.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.lean_into: Pursuing long-term collaborative projects with people who share a common vision.

TEN_GOD_FRIEND.name: Establishing Equal Presence
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.headline: Throughout this year, you will become the center of horizontal partnerships exchanging deep trust.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.body:
This is the year when a healthy and equal network of relationships, where you can walk side by side in every space of your life, is completed. You will be reborn as a skilled person who establishes your presence while willingly acknowledging others' autonomy.

You will deeply master how to communicate in complete equality, breaking away from hierarchical relationships or competitive structures. As a result, unnecessary misunderstandings and exhausting emotional consumption disappear, greatly reducing fatigue from relationships.

Relationships firmly connected by deep trust without restricting each other are the most valuable treasures you can gain this year. Share sincere conversations with those who stay by your side and solidify the bonds of your hearts.

The mutual trust accumulated throughout the year brings massive peace and pride to your life. I hope you fully enjoy the true happiness blooming within balanced relationships.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.watch_for: Feeling needlessly impatient by comparing your growth speed with others.
TEN_GOD_FRIEND.lean_into: Investing deeply in equal and honest relationships that inspire each other.

TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.name: The Sharpened Edge
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.headline: This year, you will be trained into an overwhelming master of skill unshaken by any external stimulation.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.body:
This year becomes a powerful training ground where fierce competition and external stimuli awaken your hidden potential. A strong will to surpass previous limits blooms entirely within you, pioneering a unique domain.

The rapid changes or challenging environments around you may feel overwhelming at first, but they soon become nutrients that make you even stronger. You will experience brilliant growth by objectively checking your skills and filling in the gaps.

By the end of the year, having willingly passed through the fierce growing pains, you will stand tall as a strong giant tree that no one can replace. Enjoy the thrill of proving yourself solely through your skills, unshaken by external noise.

Adopt the mindset of sharpening a harder blade every time you face a trial. The fierceness of this year will become your greatest weapon to make you shine the brightest on the distant day.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.watch_for: Wasteful pride battles or showy spending to beat others.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.lean_into: Converting external competitive stimuli solely into the driving force for strengthening your own capabilities.

TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.name: Guarding Sovereignty
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.headline: This year, you will be reborn as a subjective leader who perfectly controls your time and resources.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.body:
The long-term theme running through this year is to firmly establish the boundaries of your life and fully recover your independent sovereignty. Amidst excessive external demands or power struggles, you will clearly realize what values you truly need to protect.

You will practice not being swayed by others' gazes or interference and using your precious time and energy entirely for yourself. The wisdom to firmly draw the line when you must refuse will be naturally acquired.

By meticulously organizing your fence over the year, you complete independent dignity that proudly stands against others' shaking. You will have the thrilling experience of gripping the steering wheel of your life entirely with your own hands.

Not wasting energy on unnecessary relationships or exhausting tasks is the key to success this year. Focus only on yourself and your growth, and build a solid inner wall.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.watch_for: Getting caught up in avoidable, exhausting power struggles and wasting resources.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.lean_into: Setting clear and firm boundaries to protect your energy and assets.

TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.name: The Master of Breakthrough
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.headline: Throughout this year, you will become a pioneer who boldly breaks limits and expands your own territory.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.body:
This year is a groundbreaking year of growth where you reverse-utilize fierce tension and challenging environments to write your own myth. You reject comfortable complacency, set higher standards for yourself, and break through limits without hesitation.

Whenever you hit stagnant situations or high walls, you demonstrate the boldness to use them as a stepping stone for a leap forward. When others hesitate, you take a step ahead and make the territory of new possibilities your own.

The tenacity and boldness firmly established throughout the year will become unrivaled assets on the path you will walk. The sense of achievement gained by breaking through fear head-on elevates your self-esteem to the maximum.

Do not define your own limits, and boldly step out into a wider world. You will see the magic of the ambitions sleeping within you transforming into massive real-world achievements.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.watch_for: Making reckless and impulsive decisions swept away by impatience or anxiety.
TEN_GOD_ROB_WEALTH.lean_into: Setting high goals and boldly putting your inner drive into action.
